title: Kusanagi Nene — A Tail On Screen〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, let's end our enunciation practice here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Reading each word clearly and properly is so hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I thought you did a good job of projecting your voice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Once you learn to channel your feelings, you should be able to put on a captivating performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, let's start working on that next.
I need to keep trying my best since I'm still not very good at channeling my feelings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, but we should take a break first.
After all, it isn't good to push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right.
Then, if you don't mind, let's take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's take it nice and easy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki's told me about some of the things Tsukasa does to practice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But acting is so hard. Now that I've given it a try, I realize just how challenging it really is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's hard not to feel that way since you're still getting the hang of it. But it gets easier after it's become second nature...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
How do you normally practice, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Basic things like we did just now. Aside from practicing projecting my voice, singing and dancing are pretty crucial.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I also research how to become a better actress by seeing shows and watching movies...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, building up your stamina is also important.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Stamina?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. If you don't have enough stamina, not only will you be unable to move the way you need to, you'll also lose your concentration...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know if this has been helping at all, but I have been doing some walking before heading out for school each morning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's incredible...!
I didn't realize just how hard you had to work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I still have a long road up ahead...
But I make a point of doing everything I can in the moment.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, you're the same way, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like the same thing goes for practicing playing an instrument. Also, playing live must require a ton of stamina.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, I'm sure you've been doing a lot to help your band succeed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
When you put it that way, I suppose I have been keeping very busy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just like you, I feel that I should be doing everything I can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I already thought you and I were in the same boat, but I guess we're similar in this way too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
We're both working very hard towards our respective dreams.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I'm getting to work on this event with you, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because practicing with you has given me a chance to get to know you much better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, if the reading event does go well, the two of us should throw a little party to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to use that opportunity to talk some more with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Oh...
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that case, we have to do everything we can to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's make sure it goes really well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!
